dnsh.checkRo: The farm's site is not exposed to floods that would wash out the slurry tanks.
The digestate is spread according to the fertilisation plan in nitrate vulnerable zones.
Manure and digestate are put to use (energy or fertiliser), and the old equipment is handed over to an authorised collector.
There is a valid environmental permit, and the digestate is stored in a sealed, covered tank.
The site is not in Natura 2000 areas, or there is an environmental approval.

ch4KgPerHeadYear.sourceRo: IPCC 2006, vol. 4, ch. 10 (Tier 1, Eastern Europe, cool climate): EF = VS × B0 × 0.67 × MCF; dairy cattle, 985 kg VS/yr, B0 0.24 m³/kg VS, MCF 17% liquid / 2% solid. The mixed value (22) is the one from the Product demo (DEMO-0004). Team estimate, to be validated with the mentors

biogasKwhPerHead.sourceRo: Electricity per head per year: data sheet of the demo offer DEMO-0004 (225,000 kWh/yr for 150 head). Used only when the offer does not state the energy produced. Team estimate, to be validated

nitrogenKgPerHeadYear.sourceRo: Plant-available nitrogen from digestate, replacing mineral nitrogen (approx. half the nitrogen excreted by a dairy cow, order of magnitude from IPCC 2006 vol. 4 ch. 10). Team estimate, to be validated with the mentors

electricitySellEurPerKwh.sourceRo: Selling price of electricity to the grid: Product demo constants (data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json). Team estimate, to be validated

nitrogenEurPerKg.sourceRo: Price of the replaced mineral nitrogen: Product demo constants (data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json). Team estimate, to be validated

fertiliserDigestateUses.sourceRo: Using the digestate on own land replaces mineral nitrogen (README §6, category 4, calculation 6)

valorisingDigestateUses.sourceRo: README §6, category 4, green threshold: manure is put to use as energy or as fertiliser

safetyMarginPct.sourceRo: Margin above the threshold required by the team
